commands.label: claude-kill-extra
commands.note: Kill extra Claude Desktop instances, keep only largest (by RAM).
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$procs = Get-Process 'Claude' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($procs.Count -gt 1) { $procs | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -Skip 1 | Stop-Process -Force }; Write-Output 'Claude instances: ' + $procs.Count"

commands.label: ventoy-extract-update
commands.note: ventoy-1.1.18 zip already at Downloads. Extract + run update GPT on D: — UAC prompt will appear.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Expand-Archive -Path 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy-1.1.18-windows.zip' -DestinationPath 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy_extracted' -Force; $exe = (Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\endos\Downloads\ventoy_extracted' -Recurse -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '-u -s -g D:' -Verb RunAs -Wait; Write-Output 'DONE'"

commands.label: watchdog-reg
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$vbs = '$wsh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $wsh.Run(\"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\\Users\\endos\\Signal\\relay\\claude_watchdog.ps1\", 0, $false)'; Set-Content -Path $env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs -Value $vbs; $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$env:TEMP\watchdog_launch.vbs"; $trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn; $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit 0; Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'ClaudeWatchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1 -Settings $settings -RunLevel Highest -Force"
